faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.whichCourseQuestion: Which course should I start with?
faq.whichCourseAnswer: We recommend starting with the Phototheology Palace Course for a comprehensive foundation. If you're specifically interested in prophecy, begin with the Blueprint Course before moving to Daniel and Revelation.
faq.kidsVersionAnswer: Yes! All courses offer age-appropriate versions for children. The content is simplified with fun activities while maintaining the core biblical truths.
faq.switchAgeGroupQuestion: Can I switch between age groups?
faq.switchAgeGroupAnswer: Absolutely! You can switch age groups at any time. Your progress is tracked separately for each age group so you won't lose any completed lessons.
faq.courseOrderQuestion: Do I need to take the courses in order?
faq.courseOrderAnswer: No, each course is self-contained. However, taking the Blueprint Course before Daniel and Revelation can provide helpful foundational context.
